title: Design System: Orbital Foundry Scroll Cinema

display.purpose: Scene titles inside the cinematic overlay. One per scene.

title.purpose: Artifact card and process step titles.

body.purpose: Descriptions and field notes. Max measure 62ch.

label.purpose: Mono instrumentation: counters, stages, stacks, metadata. Uppercase, tracked 0.24em.

shadows.name: overlay-ambience
shadows.purpose: The single sanctioned shadow — seats the caption overlay into the footage. Not for cards, chips, or buttons.

motion.name: scrub-smoothing
motion.purpose: GSAP ScrollTrigger scrub value for all scene timelines.

motion.name: hover-transition
motion.purpose: Lift + color shift on buttons and cards.

motion.name: reveal-ease
motion.purpose: Caption overlay late reveal (fade + 36px rise, scrubbed).

motion.name: media-scale
motion.purpose: Subtle scene media scale over the full runway. Never zoom-heavy.

motion.name: scene-runway
motion.purpose: Full clip duration maps to full scroll runway. Never clamp playback.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Signal Ivory action block — Resume, GitHub, scene links. Square-cut, lifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; background: #f6f2e8; color: #09090b; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid rgba(246,242,232,0.18); border-radius: 0; transition: transform 0.3s, background-color 0.3s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: #dff3ff; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a5f3fc; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Stat Chip
components.description: Mono readout for stacks and stats under captions and on artifact cards. Never interactive.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(246,242,232,0.18); background: rgba(0,0,0,0.16); color: rgba(246,242,232,0.68); font-family: 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; border-radius: 0; }

components.name: Caption Overlay
components.description: The scene's voice: mono counter, eyebrow, display title, subtitle, body — seated onto footage with a left hairline and the system's only shadow.

components.css: .ds-overlay-stage { padding: 32px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 72% 18%, rgba(145,200,255,0.16), transparent 20rem), linear-gradient(180deg, #0a0d12, #030406); } .ds-overlay { max-width: 36rem; padding: 8px 12px 8px 28px; border-left: 1px solid rgba(246,242,232,0.18); background: rgba(0,0,0,0.1); backdrop-filter: blur(1px); box-shadow: -18px 0 58px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.22), 0 24px 80px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.16); font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-overlay-counter { margin: 0; font-family: 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.24em; color: rgba(246,242,232,0.42); } .ds-overlay-eyebrow { margin: 16px 0 0; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(246,242,232,0.68); } .ds-overlay-title { margin: 12px 0 0; font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.4rem); font-weight: 1000; line-height: 0.88; color: #f6f2e8; } .ds-overlay-subtitle { margin: 16px 0 0; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; color: rgba(246,242,232,0.88); } .ds-overlay-body { margin: 16px 0 0; max-width: 62ch; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.625; color: rgba(246,242,232,0.68); }

narrative.overview: An industrial space fabrication facility, traversed slowly. The four approved videos are the environment — a cold open, a rail approach, the McCallos dock, the Mimir agent-core assembly — and everything the UI does is instrumentation laid over that footage: machined captions, hairline-bordered panels, mono-spaced readouts. The register is a serious builder documentary; the primary emotion is slow awe and controlled traversal. Pacing is earned with runway: each scene owns a tall sticky scroll distance mapped to the full clip duration, never by clamping or artificial delay.
keyCharacteristics: Video is the environment; UI never competes with the footage.
Machined and exact: zero border-radius, 1px hairlines, mono labels.
Warm ivory ink on near-black void; amber and blue as scene-role accents.
Depth through atmosphere (localized gradients, glow) — not shadow stacks.
Reduced-motion and mobile users get bright poster stills and full content.

rules.name: The Visible Footage Rule
rules.body: Scene overlays are localized gradients only. Full-frame darkening beyond the documented gradients is prohibited; if text isn't readable, move or shrink the gradient, never dim the whole frame.

rules.name: The Two-Accent Rule
rules.body: Amber and blue never share a moment. Each accent belongs to a scene role (foundry warmth vs. orbital light); a surface commits to one or neither.

rules.name: The Instrument Readout Rule
rules.body: Anything mono is metadata: counters, stages, stacks, periods. Mono never carries a sentence; sentences belong to DM Sans.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: .cinematic-overlay owns the only box-shadow in the system. Everything else is flat: hairline border, tint fill, done.

dos: Do map the full clip duration to the full scene scroll runway (~520–600vh per 8s clip, scrub: 0.45) — every pixel of scroll moves the video some amount.
Do keep media scale subtle: 1.0 → 1.035, never zoom-heavy.
Do serve bright poster stills to mobile and reduced-motion users, with overlays forced visible.
Do keep text on footage readable via placement and the documented localized gradients; body text holds ≥4.5:1 against the darkest frame beneath it.
Do use 0px radius, 1px hairlines, and mono uppercase labels for every new surface — machined and exact.
donts: Don't bury the footage: no full-frame dark overlays, no re-stacking black gradients on top of the lifted video grade.
Don't paste cyber/sci-fi UI chrome on the footage — no HUD frames, glitch text, or neon grids.
Don't let the tail become a generic black SaaS dashboard — proof reads as dark field notes and artifact panels.
Don't build static card-grid portfolios or identical icon + heading + blurb cards.
Don't import the light Fluid Systems Atlas plates into the dark cinema.
Don't scroll-jack. Native scroll via Lenis; prefers-reduced-motion always gets a still, complete experience.
Don't clamp video playback to slow a scene down — lengthen the runway instead.
